what: one angry villager of seventeenth-century England, a farmer swept up in a witch-hunting crowd in 1645, painted seriously: a living man of about forty-five with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long limbs, about eight heads tall, stooped from field work. His face is furious and frightened: mouth wide open shouting, brows knotted, eyes wide, cheeks hollow, rough stubble, straggling greying brown hair under his hat, weather-beaten light tan skin.
colours: a battered dark brown felt hat, a coarse undyed grey-brown wool jerkin, a loose dirty off-white linen shirt, dark brown wool knee breeches, grey wool stockings, scuffed black leather shoes, a dark oak pitchfork pole with two dark iron tines, one grey stone.
wears: He wears a battered dark brown felt hat with a wide floppy brim, a sleeveless jerkin of coarse undyed grey-brown homespun wool laced at the front, over a loose dirty off-white linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; dark brown wool knee breeches, grey wool stockings to the knee, and scuffed black leather shoes. No armour, no cloak.
holds: He holds exactly two things: in his right hand one hayfork, a long straight pole of dark oak, scuffed and darkened with age, ending at its top in two long, thick, curved dark iron tines, held upright and thrust forward; in his raised left hand one rough grey stone as big as his fist, about to be thrown.
pose: On two legs, he lunges forward to the left, his weight on his front leg, the hayfork jabbed forward and upward in his right hand with its two tines in front of him, his left arm raised back above his shoulder to throw the grey stone, his shouting face turned toward the viewer.
must_show: a living stooped peasant man shouting, stubble, wide-brimmed felt hat
plain homespun clothes: jerkin, shirt, knee breeches, stockings
one hayfork with long iron tines in one hand
one stone raised in the other hand

what: a palace guard of Dionysius, tyrant of Syracuse, a well-paid foreign soldier of ancient Greece, painted seriously: a living, strong man of about thirty with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long limbs, about eight heads tall. His head is in a bronze Corinthian helmet that covers his face down to the chin, with two narrow eye-openings and a nose guard, his dark eyes and short black beard showing through the gap, and on top of the helmet a tall crest of stiff dark brown horsehair running front to back.
colours: polished warm bronze helmet, shield face and greaves, dark brown horsehair crest, an off-white linen cuirass with bronze scales on the belly, a dark brown leather skirt of strips, a deep madder-brown wool tunic, weather-beaten light tan skin, a dark wooden spear shaft with a bright steel head.
wears: He wears a thick off-white linen cuirass with shoulder flaps tied down on his chest and a band of small bronze scales across the belly, a skirt of hanging dark brown leather strips over a short deep brown wool tunic, polished bronze greaves on his shins, and leather sandals. His arms are bare from the shoulder.
holds: He holds exactly two things: on his left arm one big round hoplite shield, as wide as from his chin to his knee, dished, its face plain polished bronze with a raised rim and nothing painted on it; in his right hand one long spear, a straight dark wooden shaft, perfectly straight, as straight as a ruler, with a leaf-shaped steel point at the front; the back end is a small plain round knob.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward to the left in a guard's thrust, his weight on his front leg, the round bronze shield held up across his body, the spear raised over his shoulder and driven forward with the point out to the left, his crested helmet turned toward the viewer.
must_show: a bronze helmet with a tall horsehair crest
one big round plain bronze shield
off-white linen cuirass, bare arms, bronze greaves

what: the ghost of Prince Neferkaptah of ancient Egypt, a calm, proud, sorrowful ghost who keeps his bargains and is not a monster, painted seriously: the see-through ghost of a lean man of about thirty with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long limbs, about eight heads tall. He is made entirely of pale ghost-light, every part the same pale icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, nearly white, with soft darker slate-grey shadows in the folds and a faint glow round his edge: his face, his bare shaved head, his chest, his arms, his legs, his feet and his long pleated kilt alike. His face is a living man's face, calm and proud, with a straight nose, lips, and dark lined eyes that look at the viewer. The only things about him that are not ghost-coloured are his gold collar and arm bands: round his neck and over his shoulders lies a broad Egyptian collar of bright gold beads in five rows, and on each upper arm a gold band. He floats a little above where a floor would be, his bare feet hanging relaxed, toes pointing down, touching nothing.
colours: the whole figure pale icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, nearly white, with soft slate-grey shadows, the kilt the same pale icy blue; a broad bright gold bead collar and gold arm bands; one black stone game piece.
wears: He wears the ghostly shape of a long pleated linen kilt to the shins, the same pale icy blue as his body, and nothing else but his gold: the broad gold bead collar and a gold band on each upper arm. His head is shaved and bare, with no headdress and no crown.
holds: He holds exactly one thing: in his raised right hand, held up between finger and thumb a hand's width in front of his face, one senet game piece, a tall rounded cone of polished black stone as big as his fist, the darkest thing in the picture. His left hand is a bare open palm turned to the viewer, nothing in it or near it, as if inviting a game.
pose: On two legs, he floats upright in the air, turned three quarters to the viewer, his weight on one hanging leg and the other knee bent forward, his feet pointing down and touching nothing, his right hand raised holding up the black game piece as if offering a move, his left hand open and held out low to the side, his head tilted a little.
must_show: a plainly ghostly man, pale icy blue-white all over, kilt included
a calm living face, shaved head
a broad bright gold collar on his shoulders
one black game piece held up in one hand
floating, feet pointing down, touching nothing

what: the ghost of Ahwere, a princess of ancient Egypt who drowned in the Nile, a sorrowful, gentle ghost and not a monster, painted seriously: the see-through ghost of a slender young woman of about twenty with realistic adult proportions, a small head and long arms. Her face, neck, arms and hands are pale ghost-light, a pale icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, nearly white, with a faint glow round her edge. Her face is a living woman's face, grieving and gentle, with a straight nose, lips, and dark lined eyes cast down. Her long straight hair is a much darker ghost colour, deep slate-grey, hanging heavy and wet past her waist, clinging to her shoulders, with drops of water falling from its ends. On her brow is a thin gold band. She wears a long loose linen dress with sleeves to the elbow and a high round neck, in a second, much darker ghost colour, a dull slate blue-grey, the colour of a rain cloud, loose and modest, its hem streaming into one long tail of pale icy mist that sweeps away behind her to the right and curls up at its tip like a comet's tail, so that she hangs in the air and nothing of her touches the ground.
colours: pale icy blue face, neck, arms and hands, nearly white; long deep slate-grey wet hair; a loose linen dress of dull slate blue-grey, the colour of a rain cloud; a thin gold brow band; a pale icy tail of mist.
wears: She wears one long loose linen dress with elbow sleeves and a high round neck, covering her from neck to hem, in dull slate blue-grey ghost colour, and a thin gold band round her brow. No other jewellery.
holds: Her hands are empty: both pale hands are clasped together in front of her chest, fingers interlaced, as if in grief. She holds nothing.
pose: She hangs upright in the air facing the viewer and a little to the right, her head bowed and tilted to one side in sorrow, both hands clasped together at her chest, her long wet hair hanging forward over one shoulder, the long tail of mist that is the lower half of her dress curling away behind her to the right.
must_show: a plainly ghostly young woman, pale icy blue skin, see-through
long dark wet hair hanging past her waist
a loose modest linen dress in a darker ghost colour
both hands clasped at her chest, empty
a sorrowful bowed face; lower body one tail of mist, floating
